scoring_justification: The main claim is qualitative (existence of magnetization flips below critical energy and no flips above). No single numeric target from the paper; the most robust check is structural: zero crossings count and mean absolute magnetization thresholds derived from the expected behavior.

outputs.description: Magnetization time series at ε=0.2. The verifier performs a structural audit of the time series.
Magnetization time series at ε=0.4. The verifier performs a structural audit of the time series.

output_contract.notes: The verifier evaluates structural properties of the submitted CSV files after discarding an initial transient. Exact parameter values are as specified; the agent must implement the 1D spin chain model described in the instruction.

steps.description: Count zero crossings of magnetization in low-energy CSV after transient discarding. Must be at least 2 for full credit.
Compute mean absolute magnetization from high-energy CSV after transient discarding. Must be ≤0.2 for full credit; linear decay from 0.2 to 0.4.
